context_for_next_testing_agent: RTL fix from iteration_37→iteration_38 is verified. App.js no longer touches document.documentElement.dir/lang — i18n.js's languageChanged listener handles everything. If future bugs surface around dir/lang attributes, check that no other component re-introduces a competing write. rca_resolved: Root cause from iteration_37 was confirmed correct: stale useEffect in App.js was hard-pinning dir='ltr', racing the i18n.js languageChanged listener. With those 8 lines removed, i18n.js writes are now uncontested and both initial load (via applyLocaleDir(i18n.language)) and runtime toggle (via on('languageChanged', ...)) work.
